description: Create free download codes for one of the person's releases (published or scheduled), e.g. for cards at a concert or for the press. Each code unlocks the whole release or one track once, forever, in all formats, like a purchase at 0 EUR (no money, no fee, counts as given away). Returns the codes with their redeem links. Optional label only the artist sees and an expiry date. Limit per release. The codes are only created after the person confirms count and release in the browser (you get a confirmUrl to give them), afterwards studio_request_status returns them.

expiresOn.description: Last valid day (YYYY-MM-DD, Vienna time), leave out for no expiry

label.description: Short label only the artist sees, e.g. "Concert Vienna"

track.description: Track ID if the codes should unlock only this track, leave out for the whole release

name: studio_codes_create
title: Create download codes
